landing.title: Wildfire Insight Intelligence
landing.subtitle: Turn Satellite Data into Actionable Wildfire Intelligence
landing.intro1: Every year, wildfires destroy thousands of hectares of forest in Brazil and across the globe. Their impact goes far beyond burned vegetation — affecting water security, public health, biodiversity, infrastructure, and local economies.
landing.intro2: Despite the abundance of environmental and satellite data, most institutions lack fast, integrated tools to assess fire damage and guide recovery.
landing.intro3: When information is fragmented, response slows and recovery suffers.
landing.platformTitle: A Data-Driven Platform for Fire Impact and Recovery Management
landing.platformDesc: Wildfire Insight Intelligence is a web-based platform that transforms complex satellite data into clear, standardized wildfire intelligence within seconds.
landing.platformAlgo: Using scientifically validated algorithms, the platform automatically:
landing.noExpertise: No advanced expertise in remote sensing required.
landing.fromRaw: From raw imagery to operational insight — instantly.
landing.operationsDesc: Currently in pilot deployment with the Fundação Florestal in São Paulo State and with Flying Labs in Bolivia, Cameroon, Malaysia, Morocco, Mozambique, Nepal, and Sierra Leone, the platform is being applied in diverse wildfire contexts across Latin America, Africa, and Asia.
landing.operationsReadiness: These implementations span different ecosystems and institutional environments, strengthening readiness for broader regional and international deployment.
landing.servesDesc: Wildfire Insight Intelligence supports environmental agencies, local governments, climate resilience programs, and organizations managing forested and natural landscapes. It enables institutions to prioritize restoration, allocate resources more effectively, improve transparency, and reduce long-term environmental and social risk.
landing.beyondDesc1: Wildfires in São Paulo have led to emergency declarations in dozens of municipalities, affecting millions through smoke exposure, water supply risks, biodiversity loss, and economic disruption.
landing.beyondDesc2: By improving post-fire intelligence and recovery planning, the platform contributes to stronger ecosystem stability and community resilience. The initiative also integrates youth engagement and environmental awareness programs, promoting prevention culture and green skill development.
landing.whyNowDesc: As wildfire frequency and intensity increase, public institutions face greater pressure to deliver measurable results with limited budgets. Effective land and risk management requires solutions that are scientifically robust, operationally simple, and scalable across regions.
landing.whyNowConclusion: Wildfire Insight Intelligence transforms environmental data into practical governance capacity.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to Strengthen Your Fire Response Strategy?
landing.ctaDesc: If your organization is responsible for wildfire management, ecosystem restoration, or climate risk planning, we invite you to explore a pilot deployment.
landing.ctaAction: Let’s move from delayed reaction to strategic action.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Brazil Flying Labs ("we", "us", "our") operates the Wildfire Insight Intelligence platform (the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and your rights regarding your personal information.
privacy.section1Text1: When you sign in via Auth0, we receive your email address, name, and a unique user identifier. This information is used to authenticate your account and personalize your experience.
privacy.section1Text2: We use PostHog to collect anonymous usage data including page views and app lifecycle events. We identify users by email and name to improve the platform. Session replays are disabled. Analytics cookies are optional and require your consent.
privacy.section1Text3: We use Grafana Faro to collect error reports including stack traces, error messages, browser type, operating system, and session identifiers. This helps us identify and fix issues quickly.
privacy.section1Text4: If you use our mobile app and grant permission, we collect your device push notification token (via Expo Push Notifications) to send you alerts when analyses complete or deliverables are ready. The token is cleared when you log out.
privacy.section1Text5: You may create areas of interest with GeoJSON boundaries, run fire analyses, and interact with AI-powered analysis features. This content is stored on our servers to provide the Service.
privacy.section1Text6: We store your preferred language, theme (light/dark), and dashboard widget layout to personalize your experience.
privacy.section2Text: We do not collect your real-time GPS location, device identifiers (UDID, IMEI), session recordings or screen captures, keystroke logs, or device hardware specifications.
privacy.section3Text: We use the collected information to provide and maintain the Service, authenticate your identity, send push notifications you have opted into, analyze usage patterns to improve the platform, monitor and fix errors, and personalize your experience with saved preferences.
privacy.section4Text: We share data with the following third-party providers to operate the Service:
privacy.section4Item2: PostHog (US) — Usage analytics (with your cookie consent)
privacy.section4Item3: Grafana Faro — Error monitoring and logging
privacy.section5Text: We use essential cookies required for the Service to function (authentication, security). Optional analytics cookies (PostHog) are only activated with your explicit consent. You can manage your cookie preferences at any time from the Profile settings.
privacy.section6Text: On the mobile app, authentication tokens are stored securely using encrypted native storage (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android). On the web, standard browser storage is used. All data transmitted between your device and our servers is encrypted via HTTPS.
privacy.section7Text: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate data, request deletion of your data, withdraw cookie consent at any time, and export your data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at:
privacy.section8Text: The Service is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
privacy.section9Text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy within the Service. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.section10Text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, contact us at:
